events.title: Dirty vendor export
events.description: A supplier file arrives with duplicated rows, mixed date formats and blank product codes.
events.decision: Validate grain, duplicates, types and missing identifiers before joining it to production data.

events.title: Urgent CEO request
events.description: The CEO asks for a number in 20 minutes that normally requires several joins.
events.decision: Provide a clearly labeled preliminary estimate only if definitions are agreed and limitations are stated.

events.title: Conflicting reports
events.description: Finance and Sales dashboards show different revenue for the same month.
events.decision: Reconcile grain, date logic, status filters and metric definitions before choosing a source of truth.

events.title: Privacy incident
events.description: A file with unnecessary personal fields appears in a shared analysis folder.
events.decision: Stop further sharing, minimize access, follow the organization incident process and use only fields needed for analysis.

achievements.title: Evidence Driven
achievements.description: Score 80 or higher on a written insight.

tasks.title: Net Revenue Formula
tasks.context: Sales wants net revenue after a percentage discount.
tasks.prompt: If B2 is gross revenue and C2 is discount rate, write the formula for net revenue.
hints: Discount is a percentage of gross.
Multiply B2 by one minus C2.

tasks.title: Completed Revenue by Region
tasks.context: Operations wants completed revenue by region.
tasks.prompt: Group completed sample_sales rows by region and sum revenue.
tasks.expectedAnswer: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sample_sales WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region;

tasks.title: Duplicate Order Check
tasks.context: A vendor extract contains a repeated order, a missing product code and inconsistent date formatting.
tasks.prompt: Choose the checks that should happen before deduplication.
tasks.expectedAnswer: Confirm row grain; Identify duplicate business keys
hints: Know what one row should represent.
Do not delete before understanding grain.

tasks.title: A/B Test Interpretation
tasks.context: Checkout variant B converted 120 of 1,000 users while A converted 100 of 1,000 users.
tasks.prompt: What is the defensible conclusion before a significance test is run?
tasks.expectedAnswer: Variant B has a higher observed conversion rate, but statistical uncertainty must be tested before declaring it the winner.
options: Variant B has a higher observed conversion rate, but statistical uncertainty must be tested before declaring it the winner.
Variant B is proven to be better because 120 is larger than 100.
hints: Observed lift is not the same as statistical significance.

tasks.title: Write a Decision-Ready Insight
tasks.context: North delivered ₹1,200 completed revenue versus West ₹800 in the small sample.
tasks.prompt: Write one short insight that states the evidence, avoids overclaiming, and recommends a next step.
tasks.expectedAnswer: North generated ₹1,200 completed revenue versus West ₹800 in this small sample; validate the pattern over a longer period, then investigate the North drivers before reallocating effort.
